name: Home Insurance Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Home Insurance Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for home insurance solutions.

overview: Home Insurance Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach homeowners comparing homeowners insurance at purchase, renewal or after a non-renewal notice, and connect them with licensed agents.

Homeowners insurance quotes depend on property details that are cumbersome to enter online, and consumers facing a closing deadline or a non-renewal want answers fast. Inbound Call programs let homeowners call a licensed agent directly after seeing a home insurance offer, arriving with a clear reason to shop and the information about their property at hand. Agents can gather roof age, construction type and prior claims in a single conversation and often bind coverage on the same call, which is particularly valuable for buyers who must deliver proof of insurance to a lender.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of home insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners and buyers under contract who need to place or replace coverage on a primary residence, second home or rental property. The most valuable segments are recent purchasers with a closing date, homeowners facing renewal increases or non-renewal, and those bundling home and auto to reduce total premium.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for homeowners insurance quotes or rate comparisons; under contract on a home purchase with a closing date approaching; renewal notice received with a significant premium increase; non-renewed or dropped by current carrier.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "homeowners insurance quotes" and "home insurance near me", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard home insurance criteria include: owns or is closing on a residential property in a state the buyer writes; property type, approximate age and construction confirmed; roof age and condition within the carrier's acceptable range; current coverage status and reason for shopping stated; no recent unresolved claims that would exclude the risk; policy decision maker interested in a quote today.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

process.title: PPC / Traffic Acquisition

faq.q: Can you exclude properties in high-risk areas we do not write?
faq.a: Yes. Targeting can be set by state, county or ZIP, and screening can capture coastal proximity or wildfire exposure so that transfers match your underwriting footprint.

faq.q: Do you screen for roof age?
faq.a: Roof age and general condition are part of the standard screening, and thresholds can be adjusted to align with your carriers' guidelines.

faq.q: Can programs prioritise new home purchases?
faq.a: Campaigns can emphasise consumers under contract with an upcoming closing, who typically have the highest urgency and bind rate.
